description: Compare two to five exact stock tickers in one compact structured response: annual fundamentals and growth, quality ratios, stored valuation and Bullrun model context, and measured risk dials. Reports each fiscal year, source date, native quote/reporting currency and missing coverage. No currency conversion, quarterly-to-annual substitution, buy/sell ranking or generated research. Read-only. Successful results include an optional platformLink for continuing this research or reviewing the exact saved draft in Bullrun. When useful, present its descriptive link and respect its description of any settings not carried over.

include.description: Selected compact modules. Fundamentals and quality use the latest usable ANNUAL fiscal year only; valuation includes stored multiples and Bullrun model context; risk includes measured dials.

tickers.description: Two to five distinct exact Bullrun stock listing tickers, e.g. AAPL, BMW, NESN or 005930. No fuzzy company names or inferred ticker suffixes.
